newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: S&P Food to buy stake in Ralco.
newsitem.headline: S&P Food to buy stake in Ralco.

text.p: Malaysian food products firm S&P Food Industries (M) Bhd said it has signed an agreement to buy a 20 percent equity interest in Ralco Corp Bhd for 57.9 million ringgit in cash.
In a statement issued by its merchant bankers, S&P Food said it was buying the 4.196 million Ralco shares from Constructive Capital Sdn Bhd at 13.80 ringgit a share.
Ralco stock ended Wednesday trading at 12.60 ringgit.
S&P Food said the stake acquisition will enable the company to expand its participation in manufacturing activities and venture into the growing plastic industry.
Investment holding firm Ralco has subsidiaries involved in manufacturing and trading of plastic bottles, containers, boxes, crates and related materials.
S&P Food asked the stock exchange to lift the suspension of its stock from Friday. The stock was last traded on June 26 at 20.70 ringgit.
